output.question: Where can I find Hermès' latest annual report?
output.answer: Hermès’ latest annual report is available on its official finance website as the 2025 Universal Registration Document, which includes the annual financial report. You can download the official English PDF here: https://assets-finance.hermes.com/s3fs-public/node/pdf_file/2026-04/1777391712/260320_hermes_urd2025_en.pdf?VersionId=jE9NgndClrtsqa.kJW0uyG8NRg4SFCVU. Hermès also provides a digital version here: https://hermes.fr.digital-report.net/en/report/5309#title_cover_1.

key_facts.fact: Hermès' official finance site lists the 2025 Universal Registration Document as including the annual financial report.
The official English PDF is titled '2025 Universal Registration Document Including the Annual Financial Report'.
The French-language version of the document was filed with the French Financial Markets Authority on 19 March 2026.

passages.quote: 2025 Universal Registration Document (including the annual financial report)

# 2025 UNIVERSAL REGISTRATION DOCUMENT

# INCLUDING THE ANNUAL FINANCIAL REPORT
The French language version of this Document d’Enregistrement Universel (universal registration document) was filed on 19 March 2026 with the French Financial Markets Authority

caveats: Hermès labels the report a Universal Registration Document rather than simply an annual report; it explicitly states that the document includes the annual financial report.
The finance webpage's current page date was not separately stated; 2026-11-11 is the research as-of date, while the document filing date is 2026-03-19.
